files.description: An example input file for the Supervised Inspection of Calcium Transients with the SICT program. A neuron expressing the fluorescent Ca2+ indicator GCaMP6f was visualized with a 40x-oil immersion objective (Olympus UAPON40xO340-2, NA 1.35). Images were acquired using an Andor Ixon Ultra 897 EM-CCD camera by Live Acquisition software (FEI) at a frequency of 28.77 Hz. The cell was held in whole cell patch clamp at a resting potential of -70 mV. A stimulation was given to measure the Ca2+ response during a single action potential. For more details, see online methods.

files.description: Contains custom MATLAB code for the Supervised Inspection of Ca2+ Transients (SICT). Requires MATLAB with the Statistics and Machine Learning Toolbox v11.3, Image Processing Toolbox v10.2 and the Curve Fitting Toolbox 3.5.7. In addition, example files are included for testing the program. Please refer to the user's manual included as supplemental information.
